meta.name: Structured Form Workflow
meta.description: Focused creation or editing workflow with explicit field grouping, validation, progress, contextual help, and controlled actions.

purpose: Help users create or edit structured information accurately while preserving context, minimizing validation friction, preventing accidental data loss, and keeping submission actions semantically clear.
useWhen: The dominant task is creating or editing structured data.
The workflow contains several related fields requiring validation.
The user must understand field relationships before submission.
Submission may fail through validation, conflict, or permission rules.
Unsaved changes may be operationally significant.
doNotUseWhen: The task is primarily read-only review.
The interaction contains only one simple inline field.
The task is approving or rejecting existing evidence.
The workflow is better represented as a small confirmation dialog.
A long form is being split into steps only for decorative effect.

selectionQuestions: Is this a create, edit, duplicate, filter, or multi-step form?
Which field groups represent meaningful user concepts?
Which fields depend on previous values?
Which values are loaded from the server?
Can background refresh overwrite unsaved values?
When must the user be warned about unsaved changes?
Which errors belong to fields and which belong to the complete form?
Should submission keep the user on the page, close an overlay, or navigate?

regions.name: Form Page Header
regions.role: Orient the user, identify whether the workflow creates or edits data, and provide concise task context.

compact.layout: Stack breadcrumb or return action, title, description, and draft state.
compact.notes: Do not repeat the submit action here when a dedicated action region exists.

medium.notes: Keep the header subordinate to the form.

wide.placement: Top of the constrained form container.
wide.layout: Horizontal orientation and optional draft metadata.
wide.notes: Do not place several actions in the header.

ultrawide.placement: Top of the constrained form container.
ultrawide.layout: Horizontal orientation and optional draft metadata.
ultrawide.notes: The form remains constrained despite additional viewport width.

rules: The title clearly distinguishes create, edit, duplicate, or review mode.
The header does not repeat the complete entity detail header.
Unsaved or draft state is visible when operationally meaningful.

regions.name: Workflow Progress
regions.role: Communicate steps, completion state, and current position in a genuinely multi-stage workflow.
prohibitedComponents: Decorative progress for a single-page form
Clickable future steps without approved navigation behavior
Step labels taken from backend field groups
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when the workflow has meaningful stages.

compact.layout: Current step, total step count, and concise progress summary.
compact.notes: Do not force a wide horizontal stepper.

medium.layout: Compact horizontal or vertical step navigation.
medium.notes: Future-step navigation depends on workflow rules.

wide.placement: Above the active form section or in a constrained side rail.
wide.notes: Do not create steps for visual decoration.

ultrawide.placement: Above the active form section or in a constrained side rail.
ultrawide.notes: The step navigation remains visually secondary.

rules: Steps represent meaningful task stages.
The current step is exposed semantically.
Completed, current, and unavailable steps do not depend only on color.
Navigation to previous or future steps follows the approved save and validation policy.

regions.name: Form Context and Summary
regions.role: Provide concise contextual information required before editing or creating the data.
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when contextual information materially changes user input.

compact.notes: Long context may move into disclosure.

wide.placement: Before the form or in a contextual side region.
wide.notes: Do not reduce the primary form width unnecessarily.

ultrawide.placement: Before the form or in a constrained aside.

rules: Context is limited to information required to complete the form.
Technical identifiers remain hidden unless operationally necessary.
Warnings use warning semantics rather than neutral help styling.

regions.name: Form-Level Errors and Warnings
regions.role: Present cross-field, server, conflict, or workflow errors that cannot be assigned to one field.
prohibitedComponents: Toast as the only error presentation
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when form-level error, warning, or conflict exists.

compact.layout: Stacked summary with links or focus movement to affected fields.
compact.notes: Do not hide conflict details in a toast.

ultrawide.notes: Do not stretch the alert across excessive width.

rules: Field errors remain associated with fields.
Cross-field and conflict errors appear here.
Recoverable errors preserve entered values.
The first invalid field receives appropriate focus after failed submission.

regions.name: Form Sections
regions.role: Group fields according to user concepts, dependencies, and task sequence.
prohibitedComponents: Every field stretched to full page width

compact.notes: Related short fields may remain grouped only when targets and labels remain usable.

medium.layout: Primarily single-column with approved two-column short-field groups.
medium.notes: Long text and complex selectors remain full row.

wide.layout: One or two columns based on semantic grouping and expected input length.
wide.notes: The form does not expand to the complete data-table width.

ultrawide.layout: One or two columns; optional contextual help aside.
ultrawide.notes: Do not create additional columns merely to fill space.

rules: Fields are grouped by user meaning rather than DTO nesting.
Field width reflects expected input.
Labels remain visible.
Required and optional conventions are consistent.
Conditional fields preserve or clear hidden values intentionally.
Read-only values use read-only presentation rather than disabled controls when appropriate.

regions.name: Contextual Help
regions.role: Provide optional guidance for complex fields or workflow concepts without cluttering every label.
prohibitedComponents: Critical requirement available only in tooltip
Large documentation page embedded in the form

sticky.compactBehavior: Move help inline or into disclosures near the relevant section.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when the form contains concepts requiring sustained guidance.

compact.placement: Inline within the relevant form section.
compact.notes: Do not detach help from the relevant field.

medium.placement: Inline or below the relevant section.

rules: Essential instructions remain visible without hover.
Help content uses user-facing terminology.
External documentation links identify destination and behavior.

regions.name: Form Actions
regions.role: Present submission, cancellation, draft, and destructive actions with explicit semantic hierarchy.
prohibitedComponents: Submit action repeated at top and bottom without justification
Action enabled during incompatible pending state

sticky.compactBehavior: Use a compact bottom action surface only when it does not cover fields or errors.

compact.placement: After form sections or in an approved bottom action surface.
compact.layout: Primary submit full width; secondary action below or in overflow.
compact.notes: Do not obscure focused fields, virtual keyboards, or validation messages.

wide.placement: After form sections or sticky inside the form container.

ultrawide.placement: After form sections or sticky inside the constrained form container.
ultrawide.notes: Actions remain aligned to form content rather than viewport edge.

rules: One primary submission action is visually dominant.
Pending state prevents duplicate submission.
Cancellation preserves or discards values according to explicit policy.
Destructive actions require separation and confirmation.
Success behavior follows the next likely user task.

composition.columnPolicy: One primary form column with approved local two-column field groups and an optional contextual help aside on wide layouts.
spacingOwnership: The recipe owns spacing between header, progress, summary, errors, form sections, and actions.
FormSection owns spacing between its heading and fields.
FormField owns label, control, help, and error spacing.
surfacePolicy: The form may use one primary surface.
Sections do not each require an independent card.
Contextual help may use a subtle surface.
Form-level errors use semantic warning or danger treatment.
rules: Field groups follow user concepts.
The form remains constrained on wide screens.
Actions remain visually connected to the form.
Error states preserve entered values whenever recovery is possible.
prohibited: Every input stretched across the entire application canvas.
Three or more arbitrary field columns.
Duplicate local and form-library state for the same value.
Resetting dirty values during background refetch.
Absolute positioning for ordinary field layout.

actions.primaryPlacement: Dedicated form action region after the active form content.
actions.secondaryPlacement: Beside or below the primary submission action according to width.
actions.destructivePlacement: Separated from save and cancel actions in a dedicated danger area or overflow workflow.
actions.contextualPlacement: Inside the relevant field or section only when the action affects that local context.
actions.overflowPolicy: Low-frequency actions such as duplicate, reset, or advanced utilities move to overflow.
actions.compactBehavior: Primary submission may become full width; secondary actions stack or move to overflow.
rules: The primary action uses a verb describing the outcome.
Cancel is not visually equivalent to submit.
Save draft and final submit remain semantically distinct when both exist.
Destructive actions never use the ordinary primary variant.

content.headingPolicy: One h1 identifies the workflow; form sections use h2; nested groups use descriptive labels or h3 when semantically appropriate.
content.longContentPolicy: Labels, help text, validation messages, and prefilled values must support realistic domain lengths.
content.truncationPolicy: Do not truncate field labels, validation messages, or critical read-only context.
content.emptyStatePlacement: A missing required prerequisite replaces the affected form region with a prerequisite state rather than rendering unusable controls.
content.loadingStrategy: Load authoritative edit data before initialization, show stable skeletons, and avoid resetting dirty forms during background refresh.
content.errorScope: Field errors remain local; cross-field, conflict, and submission errors appear in the form-level error region.
rules: Required, optional, unknown, and unavailable values remain semantically distinct.
Help text explains constraints before users fail where appropriate.
Server validation remains authoritative.
Form content uses domain language rather than DTO property names.

responsive.minimumViewport: 320 CSS pixels with single-column form sections.
responsive.zoomExpectation: The form must remain operable at 125% browser zoom and increased text size.
responsive.internalOverflowPolicy: Complex tables or file lists nested in forms may use approved local overflow; ordinary fields must wrap or stack.

transformations.change: Keep the form container constrained and preserve the contextual help column only when it materially assists completion.
transformations.reason: Additional viewport width should not reduce reading and input accuracy.

transformations.change: Move contextual help below relevant sections and reduce two-column field groups.
transformations.reason: The primary input column requires sufficient width for labels, values, and validation.

transformations.change: Stack all ordinary field groups, simplify progress navigation, and make the primary action prominent without covering content.
transformations.reason: Compact viewports cannot safely sustain side-by-side fields and persistent contextual columns.

states.rendering: Render stable form-header and field-group skeletons before authoritative edit data is available.
states.notes: Do not initialize editable controls with incomplete placeholder values.

states.rendering: Render initialized form sections, validation support, context, and eligible actions.
Render a non-blocking warning when user input remains allowed but requires attention.
states.userAction: Review and continue or correct the relevant data.

states.rendering: Render field or form-level errors while preserving recoverable user input.
states.userAction: Correct fields, retry, or resolve conflict.

states.rendering: Render read-only or forbidden behavior according to capability and disclosure policy.
states.userAction: Return or continue in read-only mode.

states.rendering: Warn when authoritative server data changed while the user has unsaved edits.
states.userAction: Compare, reload, or continue according to conflict policy.

states.rendering: Show local submission progress, disable duplicate execution, and preserve the form.
states.userAction: Wait or cancel only when supported.

states.rendering: Render successfully loaded form sections while isolating optional failed dependencies.
states.userAction: Continue where safe or retry the affected dependency.

landmarkMap: The workflow uses the inherited main landmark.
The form uses a form landmark with an accessible name when multiple forms exist.
Step navigation uses a labeled nav landmark.
Contextual help uses an aside when persistent.
Form-level errors use an alert or labeled summary region.
headingStructure: Nested conceptual groups use h3 only when they represent meaningful sections.
focusOrder: Contextual help associated with relevant sections.
keyboard: All fields and custom controls are keyboard operable.
Failed submission moves focus to the error summary or first invalid field according to form length.
Dialogs for discard or conflict trap and restore focus.
File upload provides a non-drag interaction.
announcements: Submission pending and completion are perceivable.
Unsaved-change and conflict states are announced appropriately.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Required, invalid, pending, success, warning, and destructive meaning do not depend only on color.
rules: Placeholder text does not replace visible labels.
Disabled and read-only semantics remain distinct.
Conditional fields preserve logical focus order.
Sticky action regions must not hide focused controls.

prohibitedPatterns: Form values duplicated in local component state.
Direct submission from uncontrolled ad hoc handlers.
Form reset on every query-data change.
Artificial multi-step form without task justification.
dataMagnitude: Labels and validation messages may be substantially longer than fixture examples.
Edit forms may contain prefilled long values.
Field arrays and uploads require their own content and state contracts.
performance: Avoid rerendering the complete form for unrelated field changes.
Do not add memoization without measured need.
implementation: React Hook Form owns form state.
Zod or the approved schema layer owns client validation.
TanStack Query owns authoritative server data.
Mutation mapping converts form values into API input.
Dirty-state and conflict policies are explicit.
Machine presence conditions come from presenceDefaults; visibilityCondition prose is explanatory only.

presenceDefaults.rationale: Route-level form workflows always need task orientation and create/edit mode context.
Progress navigation exists only for genuinely multi-stage workflows.
Context summary appears only when external context materially changes how the form should be completed.
The form-level issue region collapses when there is no cross-field, conflict, or submission-level issue.
The structured input sections are the primary content of a form workflow.
Persistent contextual help exists only for workflows whose concepts require sustained guidance.
A create/edit form workflow always exposes its submission/cancellation action region; eligibility and pending state control actions inside it.

checks.description: The form-workflow recipe must validate against the layout recipe schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing recipe fields.

checks.description: Visible labels, error associations, keyboard submission, and first-invalid-field behavior must work.
checks.remediation: Correct canonical form-field composition and submission focus behavior.

checks.description: Recoverable submission errors and conflicts must preserve user-entered values.
checks.remediation: Correct mutation handling, form reset behavior, or conflict orchestration.

checks.description: Form sections and action surfaces must remain operable without page-level horizontal overflow or covered controls.
checks.remediation: Correct field grouping, container width, or sticky action behavior.

checks.description: Field grouping and widths must reflect user concepts and expected input rather than DTO structure.
checks.remediation: Reorganize form sections and field layout.

checks.description: Form progress, contextual summary, form-level errors, help, and action regions must follow typed workflow semantics rather than prose inference.
checks.remediation: Correct craftDefaults/presenceDefaults and keep conditional regions required=false with cardinality.minimum=0.
